name: Figma design to client deck (EXT file builder)
summary: Takes a Superspace project + Figma frames and builds a correctly named customer-facing Figma file (EXT_<Project Number>_<Account>_<Project>) with cover, filled-in brief, per-option rationale, updated header/footer and placed PNGs.
how_to_use: In Cowork say 'make EXT file' or 'customer-facing deck'; paste Superspace link + Figma frames link; give draft number (defaults to Draft 1); afterwards right-click Cover > Set as thumbnail manually. Review rationale/stats before sending.

name: Figma Buzz template prep
summary: Prepares Figma Design frames to become Figma Buzz templates: fixes Auto Layout/images/layer names, builds template sets, adds on/off toggles, locks non-editable elements, and creates an Excel bulk-create sheet with a guide tab. Works on a copy ('Buzz prep' page). Also useful for any component-based template you want to bulk-create.
how_to_use: Add plugin, share a Figma link with Claude and ask it to prepare the frames for Buzz.

name: AM account growth-opportunities dashboard
summary: Live artifact that loads the accounts assigned to the viewer and shows balance/expirations/usage vs plan and boosters, growth opportunities (upsell, cross-sell, client signals) and account details with pitch ideas.
how_to_use: Open the artifact; connect Superside, Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Slack (and BigQuery) connectors. Built in the Team workspace: won't open if you're logged into the Enterprise account.

name: artifact-registry (personal Artifact Finder)
summary: Builds a private Notion database of every artifact you built or that was shared with you, classifies them (live/static, purpose, scope, visibility, status) and publishes a private searchable Artifact Finder; optional weekday sync. Known issue: initially only available in Enterprise workspace (not Team); updated to keep one registry across workspaces. Users asked for team/company-wide registries.
how_to_use: Add skill, then say 'set up my artifact registry'. Needs Notion connector. Each person runs their own private copy.

name: Figma to InDesign (CMYK) converter
summary: Converts a Figma report/deck/one-pager into a native editable InDesign IDML with brand CMYK swatches, template paragraph styles, precise text frames, organized Links folder, read-me and a visual QA dashboard comparing the exported PDF against Figma. Built in response to Adelle Adrian's ask (Figma report -> print-ready INDD). Known issue: org link not accessible from other team workspaces; .skill file shared in thread instead.
how_to_use: Install; provide Figma link + pages, brand guide (CMYK values/fonts) and client InDesign template if any. Export PDF from InDesign for the QA loop.

name: Loopy Labs (motion loop templates in Figma)
summary: Library of ready-to-animate loop templates powered by Claude Skills that turns a static design into an on-brand motion ad inside Figma; loops stay editable.
how_to_use: Duplicate the Figma file and start with the 'Step by step: READ FIRST!!' page.

name: Fancy Board (PM/AM task board)
summary: Board for PMs and AMs to keep tasks organized and auto-update the calendar so deadlines/priorities stay clear. Works best for accounts with dedicated team members/CLs; Felicia Meyer has a skill to build your own.
how_to_use: Request viewer access to the artifact (Felicia Meyer admits); ask Felicia for the build-your-own skill.

name: Responsive Safe Zones Figma plugin
summary: Figma plugin built from Jess Uhren's channel mockups/safe-zones file: auto-detects format/channel from frame size+name, overlays platform safe zones, checks and fixes elements outside safe areas, and drops assets into editable platform mockups.
how_to_use: Name frames with platform + ad/organic (e.g. IG_story_ad_01). Not published: get the zip from Gabrielle, then Figma desktop > Plugins > Development > Import plugin from manifest.

name: Superspace Feedback Relay
summary: Relays client feedback from Superspace chat into the project's internal Slack channel within the hour (tagging only who needs to act) and posts a daily cross-timezone handoff (decisions, next steps, feedback, promises from meetings). Nothing posts without approval.
how_to_use: Add plugin; open Code tab in Claude desktop; say 'set up the Superspace feedback relay for account <ID>'. Needs Superspace, Slack, Google Drive connected and Gemini notes/transcripts on in meetings.

name: SuperDash / am-morning-dashboard
summary: Single role-based dashboard (PM/Producer or CL/CD) showing budgets, projects, deadlines and what's being quoted, built with Claude Code for the Booking.com team and PEAK AMs; packaged later as the am-morning-dashboard skill.
how_to_use: Open the Dash and pick your role top-right; or install am-morning-dashboard.skill from Claude's skills settings and follow the guide.

name: #Theres-A-Skill-For-That pack (account & project skills)
summary: Benitta's collection of AM/PM skills: /account-onboarding, /account-opportunity-finder, /client-behaviour-analysis, /account-cost-dispute-pack, /next-step-generator, /adhoc-project-plan-drafter, /product-design-qc, /branding-design-qc, /scoop-scheduler, /scoop-pto. Updated into a shared library so brands only need processing once.

name: Project Management Hub

name: Market & Growth Tracker artifact

how_to_use: Install and point it at a quiet account.

name: MP4 to .lottie converter

how_to_use: Install mp4-to-lottie.skill; check result at lottiefiles.com/preview.
